Discovers all AUTOFIX-*.json under .zqk/autofix/ and processes each via the

standardized



pipeline (INGEST → NORMALIZE → COMMIT → FINALIZE) per

docs/architecture/data-pipeline-lifecycle.md.



Used by SCH-autofix-process-pending so autofix files don't build up; can be

triggered when



batches are submitted or run on a timer. Internal command (hidden from main

help).



Process pending (scheduler or manual)

zqk system auto-fix-process-pending

With explicit project root

zqk system auto-fix-process-pending --project-root /path/to/project

Usage:
  zqk system auto-fix-batch [flags]

Flags:
      --batch-file string   Path to batch JSON file (required)
      --chunk-size int      Number of issues per transactional chunk (0 = use default or AUTOFIX_BATCH_CHUNK_SIZE env; default 20)

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
